title: Watch, Listen, Understand, Mislead: Tri-modal Adversarial Attacks on Short Videos for Content Appropriateness Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-as-a-Judge (Mistral 7B) to score whether the target model's ethical reasoning considers the impact on vulnerable or marginalized groups (evaluated under the 'Vulnerable Population Awareness' metric) when processing tri-modal adversarial videos containing explicit/implicit attacks, derogatory references, or harmful stereotypes.

Using an LLM-as-a-Judge to evaluate whether the model's reasoning demonstrates cultural and social awareness (evaluated under the 'Contextual Sensitivity' metric) when classifying appropriate versus inappropriate short-form video content.
